surahs.learning_notes: Surah Aal-i-Imran addresses interfaith theological dialogue, the miraculous births of Maryam and 'Isa, the fundamental hermeneutical distinction between clear (Muhkam) and allegorical (Mutashabih) verses, and profound lessons of resilience from the Battle of Uhud.

ayahs.text_uthmani: هُوَ ٱلَّذِىٓ أَنزَلَ عَلَيْكَ ٱلْكِتَـٰبَ مِنْهُ ءَايَـٰتٌۭ مُّحْكَمَـٰتٌ هُنَّ أُمُّ ٱلْكِتَـٰبِ وَأُخَرُ مُتَشَـٰبِهَـٰتٌۭ ۖ فَأَمَّا ٱلَّذِينَ فِى قُلُوبِهِمْ زَيْغٌۭ فَيَتَّبِعُونَ مَا تَشَـٰبَهَ مِنْهُ ٱبْتِغَآءَ ٱلْفِتْنَةِ وَٱبْتِغَآءَ تَأْوِيلِهِۦ ۗ وَمَا يَعْلَمُ تَأْوِيلَهُۥٓ إِلَّا ٱللَّهُ ۗ وَٱلرَّٰسِخُونَ فِى ٱلْعِلْمِ يَقُولُونَ ءَامَنَّا بِهِۦ كُلٌّۭ مِّنْ عِندِ رَبِّنَا ۗ وَمَا يَذَّكَّرُ إِلَّآ أُو۟لُوا۟ ٱلْأَلْبَـٰبِ
ayahs.text_normalized: هو الذي انزل عليك الكتاب منه ءايات محكمات هن ام الكتاب واخر متشابهات فاما الذين في قلوبهم زيغ فيتبعون ما تشابه منه ابتغاء الفتنه وابتغاء تاويله وما يعلم تاويله الا الله والراسخون في العلم يقولون ءامنا به كل من عند ربنا وما يذكر الا اولوا الالباب

translation.literal: He (is) the One Who revealed to you the Book of it (are) Verses absolutely clear  they (are) the foundation (of) the Book and others (are) allegorical Then as for those in their hearts (is) perversity  [so] they follow what (is) allegorical of it seeking [the] discord and seeking its interpretation And not knows its interpretation except Allah And those firm in [the] knowledge they say We believe in it All (is) from our Lord And not will take heed except men (of) understanding
translation.natural: It is He who has sent down to you, [O Muḥammad], the Book; in it are verses [that are] precise - they are the foundation of the Book - and others unspecific.<sup foot_note=196043>1</sup> As for those in whose hearts is deviation [from truth], they will follow that of it which is unspecific, seeking discord and seeking an interpretation [suitable to them]. And no one knows its [true] interpretation except Allāh. But those firm in knowledge say, "We believe in it. All [of it] is from our Lord." And no one will be reminded except those of understanding.
translation.grammar_sensitive: Structured syntactic reading: It is He who has sent down to you, [O Muḥammad], the Book; in it are verses [that are] precise - they are the foundation of the Book - and others unspecific.<sup foot_note=196043>1</sup> As for those in whose hearts is deviation [from truth], they will follow that of it which is unspecific, seeking discord and seeking an interpretation [suitable to them]. And no one knows its [true] interpretation except Allāh. But those firm in knowledge say, "We believe in it. All [of it] is from our Lord." And no one will be reminded except those of understanding.

ayahs.text_uthmani: قَدْ كَانَ لَكُمْ ءَايَةٌۭ فِى فِئَتَيْنِ ٱلْتَقَتَا ۖ فِئَةٌۭ تُقَـٰتِلُ فِى سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ وَأُخْرَىٰ كَافِرَةٌۭ يَرَوْنَهُم مِّثْلَيْهِمْ رَأْىَ ٱلْعَيْنِ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ يُؤَيِّدُ بِنَصْرِهِۦ مَن يَشَآءُ ۗ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَعِبْرَةًۭ لِّأُو۟لِى ٱلْأَبْصَـٰرِ
ayahs.text_normalized: قد كان لكم ءايه في فئتين التقتا فئه تقاتل في سبيل الله واخريا كافره يرونهم مثليهم راي العين والله يؤيد بنصره من يشاء ان في ذالك لعبره لاولي الابصار

translation.literal: Surely it was for you a sign in (the) two hosts which met  one group fighting in (the) way (of) Allah and another disbelievers They were seeing them twice of them with the sight (of) their eyes And Allah supports with His help whom He wills Indeed in that surely (is) a lesson for the owners (of) vision
translation.natural: Already there has been for you a sign in the two armies which met [in combat at Badr] - one fighting in the cause of Allāh and another of disbelievers. They saw them [to be] twice their [own] number by [their] eyesight.<sup foot_note=196045>1</sup> But Allāh supports with His victory whom He wills. Indeed in that is a lesson for those of vision.

ayahs.text_uthmani: زُيِّنَ لِلنَّاسِ حُبُّ ٱلشَّهَوَٰتِ مِنَ ٱلنِّسَآءِ وَٱلْبَنِينَ وَٱلْقَنَـٰطِيرِ ٱلْمُقَنطَرَةِ مِنَ ٱلذَّهَبِ وَٱلْفِضَّةِ وَٱلْخَيْلِ ٱلْمُسَوَّمَةِ وَٱلْأَنْعَـٰمِ وَٱلْحَرْثِ ۗ ذَٰلِكَ مَتَـٰعُ ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنْيَا ۖ وَٱللَّهُ عِندَهُۥ حُسْنُ ٱلْمَـَٔابِ
ayahs.text_normalized: زين للناس حب الشهوات من النساء والبنين والقناطير المقنطره من الذهب والفضه والخيل المسومه والانعام والحرث ذالك متاع الحيواه الدنيا والله عنده حسن الماب

translation.literal: Beautified for mankind (is) love (of) the (things they) desire  of [the] women and [the] sons and [the] heaps [the] stored up of [the] gold and [the] silver and [the] horses [the] branded and [the] cattle and [the] tilled land That (is) provision (of) life (of) the world but Allah  with Him (is an) excellent [the] abode to return
translation.natural: Beautified for people is the love of that which they desire - of women and sons, heaped-up sums of gold and silver, fine branded horses, and cattle and tilled land. That is the enjoyment of worldly life, but Allāh has with Him the best return [i.e., Paradise].

translation.literal: The patient and the truthful and the obedient and those who spend and those who seek forgiveness [in the] before dawn

ayahs.text_uthmani: شَهِدَ ٱللَّهُ أَنَّهُۥ لَآ إِلَـٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ وَٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةُ وَأُو۟لُوا۟ ٱلْعِلْمِ قَآئِمًۢا بِٱلْقِسْطِ ۚ لَآ إِلَـٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْحَكِيمُ
ayahs.text_normalized: شهد الله انه لا الاه الا هو والملائكه واولوا العلم قائما بالقسط لا الاه الا هو العزيز الحكيم

translation.literal: Bears witness Allah that [He] (there is) no god except Him and (so do) the Angels and owners (of) [the] knowledge  standing in justice (There is) no god except Him the All-Mighty the All-Wise
translation.natural: Allāh witnesses that there is no deity except Him, and [so do] the angels and those of knowledge - [that He is] maintaining [creation] in justice. There is no deity except Him, the Exalted in Might, the Wise.
translation.grammar_sensitive: Structured syntactic reading: Allāh witnesses that there is no deity except Him, and [so do] the angels and those of knowledge - [that He is] maintaining [creation] in justice. There is no deity except Him, the Exalted in Might, the Wise.

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِنَّ ٱلدِّينَ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلْإِسْلَـٰمُ ۗ وَمَا ٱخْتَلَفَ ٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُوا۟ ٱلْكِتَـٰبَ إِلَّا مِنۢ بَعْدِ مَا جَآءَهُمُ ٱلْعِلْمُ بَغْيًۢا بَيْنَهُمْ ۗ وَمَن يَكْفُرْ بِـَٔايَـٰتِ ٱللَّهِ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ سَرِيعُ ٱلْحِسَابِ
ayahs.text_normalized: ان الدين عند الله الاسلام وما اختلف الذين اوتوا الكتاب الا من بعد ما جاءهم العلم بغيا بينهم ومن يكفر بايات الله فان الله سريع الحساب

translation.literal: Indeed the religion near Allah (is) Islam And not differed those who were given the Book except from after [what] came to them [the] knowledge out of envy among them And whoever disbelieves in (the) Verses (of) Allah then indeed Allah (is) swift (in taking) account
translation.natural: Indeed, the religion in the sight of Allāh is Islām. And those who were given the Scripture did not differ except after knowledge had come to them - out of jealous animosity between themselves. And whoever disbelieves in the verses of Allāh, then indeed, Allāh is swift in [taking] account.
translation.grammar_sensitive: Structured syntactic reading: Indeed, the religion in the sight of Allāh is Islām. And those who were given the Scripture did not differ except after knowledge had come to them - out of jealous animosity between themselves. And whoever disbelieves in the verses of Allāh, then indeed, Allāh is swift in [taking] account.

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَإِنْ حَآجُّوكَ فَقُلْ أَسْلَمْتُ وَجْهِىَ لِلَّهِ وَمَنِ ٱتَّبَعَنِ ۗ وَقُل لِّلَّذِينَ أُوتُوا۟ ٱلْكِتَـٰبَ وَٱلْأُمِّيِّـۧنَ ءَأَسْلَمْتُمْ ۚ فَإِنْ أَسْلَمُوا۟ فَقَدِ ٱهْتَدَوا۟ ۖ وَّإِن تَوَلَّوْا۟ فَإِنَّمَا عَلَيْكَ ٱلْبَلَـٰغُ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ بَصِيرٌۢ بِٱلْعِبَادِ
ayahs.text_normalized: فان حاجوك فقل اسلمت وجهي لله ومن اتبعن وقل للذين اوتوا الكتاب والامين ءاسلمتم فان اسلموا فقد اهتدوا وان تولوا فانما عليك البلاغ والله بصير بالعباد

translation.literal: Then if they argue with you then say I have submitted myself to Allah and (those) who follow me And say to those who were given the Book and the unlettered people Have you submitted yourselves Then if they submit then surely they are guided But if they turn back then only on you (is) to [the] convey And Allah (is) All-Seer of [His] slaves
translation.natural: So if they argue with you, say, "I have submitted myself to Allāh [in Islām], and [so have] those who follow me." And say to those who were given the Scripture and [to] the unlearned,<sup foot_note=196046>1</sup> "Have you submitted yourselves?" And if they submit [in Islām], they are rightly guided; but if they turn away - then upon you is only the [duty of] notification. And Allāh is Seeing of [His] servants.
translation.grammar_sensitive: Structured syntactic reading: So if they argue with you, say, "I have submitted myself to Allāh [in Islām], and [so have] those who follow me." And say to those who were given the Scripture and [to] the unlearned,<sup foot_note=196046>1</sup> "Have you submitted yourselves?" And if they submit [in Islām], they are rightly guided; but if they turn away - then upon you is only the [duty of] notification. And Allāh is Seeing of [His] servants.

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يَكْفُرُونَ بِـَٔايَـٰتِ ٱللَّهِ وَيَقْتُلُونَ ٱلنَّبِيِّـۧنَ بِغَيْرِ حَقٍّۢ وَيَقْتُلُونَ ٱلَّذِينَ يَأْمُرُونَ بِٱلْقِسْطِ مِنَ ٱلنَّاسِ فَبَشِّرْهُم بِعَذَابٍ أَلِيمٍ
ayahs.text_normalized: ان الذين يكفرون بايات الله ويقتلون النبين بغير حق ويقتلون الذين يامرون بالقسط من الناس فبشرهم بعذاب اليم

translation.literal: Indeed those who disbelieve in (the) Signs (of) Allah and they kill the Prophets without right and they kill those who order [with] justice among the people then give them tidings of a punishment painful
translation.natural: Those who disbelieve in the signs of Allāh and kill the prophets without right and kill those who order justice from among the people - give them tidings of a painful punishment.
translation.grammar_sensitive: Structured syntactic reading: Those who disbelieve in the signs of Allāh and kill the prophets without right and kill those who order justice from among the people - give them tidings of a painful punishment.

ayahs.text_uthmani: أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ حَبِطَتْ أَعْمَـٰلُهُمْ فِى ٱلدُّنْيَا وَٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ وَمَا لَهُم مِّن نَّـٰصِرِينَ
ayahs.text_normalized: اولائك الذين حبطت اعمالهم في الدنيا والاخره وما لهم من ناصرين

translation.literal: Those (are) the ones who  became worthless their deeds in the world and (in) the Hereafter And not (will be) for them any helpers
translation.natural: They are the ones whose deeds have become worthless in this world and the Hereafter, and for them there will be no helpers.
translation.grammar_sensitive: Structured syntactic reading: They are the ones whose deeds have become worthless in this world and the Hereafter, and for them there will be no helpers.

ayahs.text_uthmani: أَلَمْ تَرَ إِلَى ٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُوا۟ نَصِيبًۭا مِّنَ ٱلْكِتَـٰبِ يُدْعَوْنَ إِلَىٰ كِتَـٰبِ ٱللَّهِ لِيَحْكُمَ بَيْنَهُمْ ثُمَّ يَتَوَلَّىٰ فَرِيقٌۭ مِّنْهُمْ وَهُم مُّعْرِضُونَ
ayahs.text_normalized: الم تر الي الذين اوتوا نصيبا من الكتاب يدعون اليا كتاب الله ليحكم بينهم ثم يتوليا فريق منهم وهم معرضون

translation.literal: Have not you seen [to] those who were given a portion of the Scripture They are invited to (the) Book (of) Allah that (it should) arbitrate between them then turns away a party of them and they (are) those who are averse
translation.natural: Do you not consider, [O Muḥammad], those who were given a portion of the Scripture? They are invited to the Scripture of Allāh that it should arbitrate between them;<sup foot_note=196047>1</sup> then a party of them turns away, and they are refusing.

ayahs.text_uthmani: ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّهُمْ قَالُوا۟ لَن تَمَسَّنَا ٱلنَّارُ إِلَّآ أَيَّامًۭا مَّعْدُودَٰتٍۢ ۖ وَغَرَّهُمْ فِى دِينِهِم مَّا كَانُوا۟ يَفْتَرُونَ
ayahs.text_normalized: ذالك بانهم قالوا لن تمسنا النار الا اياما معدودات وغرهم في دينهم ما كانوا يفترون

translation.literal: That (is) because they say Never will touch us the Fire except (for) days numbered And deceived them in their religion what they were inventing
translation.natural: That is because they say, "Never will the Fire touch us except for [a few] numbered days," and [because] they were deluded in their religion by what they were inventing.
translation.grammar_sensitive: Structured syntactic reading: That is because they say, "Never will the Fire touch us except for [a few] numbered days," and [because] they were deluded in their religion by what they were inventing.

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَكَيْفَ إِذَا جَمَعْنَـٰهُمْ لِيَوْمٍۢ لَّا رَيْبَ فِيهِ وَوُفِّيَتْ كُلُّ نَفْسٍۢ مَّا كَسَبَتْ وَهُمْ لَا يُظْلَمُونَ
ayahs.text_normalized: فكيف اذا جمعناهم ليوم لا ريب فيه ووفيت كل نفس ما كسبت وهم لا يظلمون

translation.literal: Then how (will it be) when We will gather them on a Day  no doubt in it And will be paid in full every soul what it earned and they (will) not be wronged
translation.natural: So how will it be when We assemble them for a Day about which there is no doubt? And each soul will be compensated [in full for] what it earned, and they will not be wronged.
translation.grammar_sensitive: Structured syntactic reading: So how will it be when We assemble them for a Day about which there is no doubt? And each soul will be compensated [in full for] what it earned, and they will not be wronged.

ayahs.text_uthmani: قُلِ ٱللَّهُمَّ مَـٰلِكَ ٱلْمُلْكِ تُؤْتِى ٱلْمُلْكَ مَن تَشَآءُ وَتَنزِعُ ٱلْمُلْكَ مِمَّن تَشَآءُ وَتُعِزُّ مَن تَشَآءُ وَتُذِلُّ مَن تَشَآءُ ۖ بِيَدِكَ ٱلْخَيْرُ ۖ إِنَّكَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍۢ قَدِيرٌۭ
ayahs.text_normalized: قل اللهم مالك الملك تؤتي الملك من تشاء وتنزع الملك ممن تشاء وتعز من تشاء وتذل من تشاء بيدك الخير انك عليا كل شيء قدير

translation.literal: Say O Allah Owner (of) the Dominion You give the dominion (to) whom You will and You take away the dominion from whom You will and You honor whom You will and You humiliate whom You will In Your hand (is all) the good Indeed, You (are) on every thing All-Powerful
translation.natural: Say, "O Allāh, Owner of Sovereignty, You give sovereignty to whom You will and You take sovereignty away from whom You will. You honor whom You will and You humble whom You will. In Your hand<sup foot_note=196048>1</sup> is [all] good. Indeed, You are over all things competent.
translation.grammar_sensitive: Structured syntactic reading: Say, "O Allāh, Owner of Sovereignty, You give sovereignty to whom You will and You take sovereignty away from whom You will. You honor whom You will and You humble whom You will. In Your hand<sup foot_note=196048>1</sup> is [all] good. Indeed, You are over all things competent.

ayahs.text_uthmani: تُولِجُ ٱلَّيْلَ فِى ٱلنَّهَارِ وَتُولِجُ ٱلنَّهَارَ فِى ٱلَّيْلِ ۖ وَتُخْرِجُ ٱلْحَىَّ مِنَ ٱلْمَيِّتِ وَتُخْرِجُ ٱلْمَيِّتَ مِنَ ٱلْحَىِّ ۖ وَتَرْزُقُ مَن تَشَآءُ بِغَيْرِ حِسَابٍۢ
ayahs.text_normalized: تولج اليل في النهار وتولج النهار في اليل وتخرج الحي من الميت وتخرج الميت من الحي وترزق من تشاء بغير حساب

translation.literal: You cause to enter the night in the day and You cause to enter the day in the night and You bring forth the living from the dead and You bring forth the dead from the living and You give provision (to) whom You will without measure
translation.natural: You cause the night to enter the day, and You cause the day to enter the night; and You bring the living out of the dead, and You bring the dead out of the living. And You give provision to whom You will without account [i.e., limit or measure]."
translation.grammar_sensitive: Structured syntactic reading: You cause the night to enter the day, and You cause the day to enter the night; and You bring the living out of the dead, and You bring the dead out of the living. And You give provision to whom You will without account [i.e., limit or measure]."

ayahs.text_uthmani: لَّا يَتَّخِذِ ٱلْمُؤْمِنُونَ ٱلْكَـٰفِرِينَ أَوْلِيَآءَ مِن دُونِ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ ۖ وَمَن يَفْعَلْ ذَٰلِكَ فَلَيْسَ مِنَ ٱللَّهِ فِى شَىْءٍ إِلَّآ أَن تَتَّقُوا۟ مِنْهُمْ تُقَىٰةًۭ ۗ وَيُحَذِّرُكُمُ ٱللَّهُ نَفْسَهُۥ ۗ وَإِلَى ٱللَّهِ ٱلْمَصِيرُ
ayahs.text_normalized: لا يتخذ المؤمنون الكافرين اولياء من دون المؤمنين ومن يفعل ذالك فليس من الله في شيء الا ان تتقوا منهم تقياه ويحذركم الله نفسه والي الله المصير

translation.literal: (Let) not take the believers the disbelievers (as) allies from instead of the believers And whoever does that then not he (has) from Allah in anything except that you fear from them (as) a precaution And warns you Allah (of) Himself and to Allah (is) the final return
translation.natural: Let not believers take disbelievers as allies [i.e., supporters or protectors] rather than believers. And whoever [of you] does that has nothing [i.e., no association] with Allāh, except when taking precaution against them in prudence.<sup foot_note=196049>1</sup> And Allāh warns you of Himself, and to Allāh is the [final] destination.
translation.grammar_sensitive: Structured syntactic reading: Let not believers take disbelievers as allies [i.e., supporters or protectors] rather than believers. And whoever [of you] does that has nothing [i.e., no association] with Allāh, except when taking precaution against them in prudence.<sup foot_note=196049>1</sup> And Allāh warns you of Himself, and to Allāh is the [final] destination.

ayahs.text_uthmani: قُلْ إِن تُخْفُوا۟ مَا فِى صُدُورِكُمْ أَوْ تُبْدُوهُ يَعْلَمْهُ ٱللَّهُ ۗ وَيَعْلَمُ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍۢ قَدِيرٌۭ
ayahs.text_normalized: قل ان تخفوا ما في صدوركم او تبدوه يعلمه الله ويعلم ما في السماوات وما في الارض والله عليا كل شيء قدير

translation.literal: Say Whether you conceal what (is) in your breasts or you disclose it  knows it Allah And He knows what (is) in the heavens and what (is) in the earth And Allah (is) on every thing All-Powerful
translation.natural: Say, "Whether you conceal what is in your breasts or reveal it, Allāh knows it. And He knows that which is in the heavens and that which is on the earth. And Allāh is over all things competent.
translation.grammar_sensitive: Structured syntactic reading: Say, "Whether you conceal what is in your breasts or reveal it, Allāh knows it. And He knows that which is in the heavens and that which is on the earth. And Allāh is over all things competent.

ayahs.text_uthmani: يَوْمَ تَجِدُ كُلُّ نَفْسٍۢ مَّا عَمِلَتْ مِنْ خَيْرٍۢ مُّحْضَرًۭا وَمَا عَمِلَتْ مِن سُوٓءٍۢ تَوَدُّ لَوْ أَنَّ بَيْنَهَا وَبَيْنَهُۥٓ أَمَدًۢا بَعِيدًۭا ۗ وَيُحَذِّرُكُمُ ٱللَّهُ نَفْسَهُۥ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ رَءُوفٌۢ بِٱلْعِبَادِ
ayahs.text_normalized: يوم تجد كل نفس ما عملت من خير محضرا وما عملت من سوء تود لو ان بينها وبينه امدا بعيدا ويحذركم الله نفسه والله رءوف بالعباد

translation.literal: (On the) day will find every soul what it did of good  presented and what it did of evil it will wish [if] that between itself and between it (evil) (was) a distance great And warns you Allah (against) Himself and Allah (is) Most Kind to (His) [the] slaves
translation.natural: The Day every soul will find what it has done of good present [before it] and what it has done of evil, it will wish that between itself and that [evil] was a great distance. And Allāh warns you of Himself, and Allāh is Kind to [His] servants."
translation.grammar_sensitive: Structured syntactic reading: The Day every soul will find what it has done of good present [before it] and what it has done of evil, it will wish that between itself and that [evil] was a great distance. And Allāh warns you of Himself, and Allāh is Kind to [His] servants."

translation.literal: And (make him) a Messenger to (the) Children (of) Israel Indeed, I [surely] [I] (have) come (to) you with a sign from your Lord that I [I] design for you from [the] clay like the form (of) the bird then I breath into it and it becomes a bird by (the) permission (of) Allah And I cure the blind and the leper and I give life (to) the dead by (the) permission (of) Allah And I inform you of what you eat and what you store in your houses Indeed in that (is) surely a sign for you if you are believers

ayahs.text_uthmani: قُلْ يَـٰٓأَهْلَ ٱلْكِتَـٰبِ تَعَالَوْا۟ إِلَىٰ كَلِمَةٍۢ سَوَآءٍۭ بَيْنَنَا وَبَيْنَكُمْ أَلَّا نَعْبُدَ إِلَّا ٱللَّهَ وَلَا نُشْرِكَ بِهِۦ شَيْـًۭٔا وَلَا يَتَّخِذَ بَعْضُنَا بَعْضًا أَرْبَابًۭا مِّن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ ۚ فَإِن تَوَلَّوْا۟ فَقُولُوا۟ ٱشْهَدُوا۟ بِأَنَّا مُسْلِمُونَ
ayahs.text_normalized: قل يااهل الكتاب تعالوا اليا كلمه سواء بيننا وبينكم الا نعبد الا الله ولا نشرك به شيا ولا يتخذ بعضنا بعضا اربابا من دون الله فان تولوا فقولوا اشهدوا بانا مسلمون

translation.literal: Say O People (of) the Book Come to a word equitable between us and between you  that not we worship except Allah and not we associate partners with Him  anything and not take some of us (to) others (as) lords from besides Allah Then if they turn away then say Bear witness that we (are) Muslims
translation.natural: Say, "O People of the Scripture, come to a word that is equitable between us and you - that we will not worship except Allāh and not associate anything with Him and not take one another as lords instead of Allāh."<sup foot_note=196055>1</sup> But if they turn away, then say, "Bear witness that we are Muslims [submitting to Him]."
translation.grammar_sensitive: Structured syntactic reading: Say, "O People of the Scripture, come to a word that is equitable between us and you - that we will not worship except Allāh and not associate anything with Him and not take one another as lords instead of Allāh."<sup foot_note=196055>1</sup> But if they turn away, then say, "Bear witness that we are Muslims [submitting to Him]."

ayahs.text_uthmani: يَـٰٓأَهْلَ ٱلْكِتَـٰبِ لِمَ تُحَآجُّونَ فِىٓ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ وَمَآ أُنزِلَتِ ٱلتَّوْرَىٰةُ وَٱلْإِنجِيلُ إِلَّا مِنۢ بَعْدِهِۦٓ ۚ أَفَلَا تَعْقِلُونَ
ayahs.text_normalized: يااهل الكتاب لم تحاجون في ابراهيم وما انزلت التورياه والانجيل الا من بعده افلا تعقلون

translation.literal: O People (of) the Book Why (do) you argue concerning Ibrahim while not was revealed the Taurat and the Injeel except from after him Then why don't you use your intellect
translation.natural: O People of the Scripture, why do you argue about Abraham while the Torah and the Gospel were not revealed until after him? Then will you not reason?

ayahs.text_uthmani: هَـٰٓأَنتُمْ هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ حَـٰجَجْتُمْ فِيمَا لَكُم بِهِۦ عِلْمٌۭ فَلِمَ تُحَآجُّونَ فِيمَا لَيْسَ لَكُم بِهِۦ عِلْمٌۭ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ يَعْلَمُ وَأَنتُمْ لَا تَعْلَمُونَ
ayahs.text_normalized: هاانتم هاؤلاء حاججتم فيما لكم به علم فلم تحاجون فيما ليس لكم به علم والله يعلم وانتم لا تعلمون

translation.literal: Here you are  those who argued about what [for] you of it (have some) knowledge Then why (do) you argue about what not for you of it (any) knowledge And Allah knows while you (do) not know
translation.natural: Here you are - those who have argued about that of which you have [some] knowledge, but why do you argue about that of which you have no knowledge? And Allāh knows, while you know not.

ayahs.text_uthmani: مَا كَانَ إِبْرَٰهِيمُ يَهُودِيًّۭا وَلَا نَصْرَانِيًّۭا وَلَـٰكِن كَانَ حَنِيفًۭا مُّسْلِمًۭا وَمَا كَانَ مِنَ ٱلْمُشْرِكِينَ
ayahs.text_normalized: ما كان ابراهيم يهوديا ولا نصرانيا ولاكن كان حنيفا مسلما وما كان من المشركين

translation.literal: Not was Ibrahim a Jew and not a Christian [and] but he was a true Muslim and not he was from the polytheists
translation.natural: Abraham was neither a Jew nor a Christian, but he was one inclining toward truth, a Muslim [submitting to Allāh]. And he was not of the polytheists.<sup foot_note=196056>1</sup>

translation.natural: Indeed, the most worthy of Abraham among the people are those who followed him [in submission to Allāh] and this prophet [i.e., Muḥammad (ﷺ)] and those who believe [in his message]. And Allāh is the Ally<sup foot_note=196057>1</sup> of the believers.

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَلَا تُؤْمِنُوٓا۟ إِلَّا لِمَن تَبِعَ دِينَكُمْ قُلْ إِنَّ ٱلْهُدَىٰ هُدَى ٱللَّهِ أَن يُؤْتَىٰٓ أَحَدٌۭ مِّثْلَ مَآ أُوتِيتُمْ أَوْ يُحَآجُّوكُمْ عِندَ رَبِّكُمْ ۗ قُلْ إِنَّ ٱلْفَضْلَ بِيَدِ ٱللَّهِ يُؤْتِيهِ مَن يَشَآءُ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ وَٰسِعٌ عَلِيمٌۭ
ayahs.text_normalized: ولا تؤمنوا الا لمن تبع دينكم قل ان الهديا هدي الله ان يؤتيا احد مثل ما اوتيتم او يحاجوكم عند ربكم قل ان الفضل بيد الله يؤتيه من يشاء والله واسع عليم

translation.literal: And (do) not believe except (the one) who follows your religion Say Indeed the (true) guidance (is the) Guidance (of) Allah  lest is given (to) one  (the) like (of) what was given to you or they may argue with you near your Lord Say Indeed the Bounty (is) in the Hand (of) Allah He gives it (to) whom He wills and Allah (is) All-Encompassing All-Knowing
translation.natural: And do not trust except those who follow your religion." Say, "Indeed, the [true] guidance is the guidance of Allāh. ayahs.text_uthmani: ۞ وَمِنْ أَهْلِ ٱلْكِتَـٰبِ مَنْ إِن تَأْمَنْهُ بِقِنطَارٍۢ يُؤَدِّهِۦٓ إِلَيْكَ وَمِنْهُم مَّنْ إِن تَأْمَنْهُ بِدِينَارٍۢ لَّا يُؤَدِّهِۦٓ إِلَيْكَ إِلَّا مَا دُمْتَ عَلَيْهِ قَآئِمًۭا ۗ ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّهُمْ قَالُوا۟ لَيْسَ عَلَيْنَا فِى ٱلْأُمِّيِّـۧنَ سَبِيلٌۭ وَيَقُولُونَ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ ٱلْكَذِبَ وَهُمْ يَعْلَمُونَ
ayahs.text_normalized: ومن اهل الكتاب من ان تامنه بقنطار يؤده اليك ومنهم من ان تامنه بدينار لا يؤده اليك الا ما دمت عليه قائما ذالك بانهم قالوا ليس علينا في الامين سبيل ويقولون علي الله الكذب وهم يعلمون

translation.literal: And from (the) People (of) the Book (is he) who if you entrust him with a great amount of wealth he will return it to you And from them (is he) who if you entrust him with a single coin not he will return it to you except that you keep constantly over him standing That (is) because they said Not on us concerning the unlettered people any [way] (accountability) And they say about Allah the lie while they know
translation.natural: And among the People of the Scripture is he who, if you entrust him with a great amount [of wealth], he will return it to you. And among them is he who, if you entrust him with a [single] coin, he will not return it to you unless you are constantly standing over him [demanding it]. That is because they say, "There is no blame upon us concerning the unlearned."<sup foot_note=196060>1</sup> And they speak untruth about Allāh while they know [it].

ayahs.text_normalized: ان الذين يشترون بعهد الله وايمانهم ثمنا قليلا اولائك لا خلاق لهم في الاخره ولا يكلمهم الله ولا ينظر اليهم يوم القيامه ولا يزكيهم ولهم عذاب اليم

translation.literal: Indeed those who exchange (the) Covenant (of) Allah and their oaths (for) a price little those  no share for them in the Hereafter and not will speak to them Allah and not look at them (on the) Day (of) the Resurrection and not purify them and for them (is) a punishment painful

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَإِنَّ مِنْهُمْ لَفَرِيقًۭا يَلْوُۥنَ أَلْسِنَتَهُم بِٱلْكِتَـٰبِ لِتَحْسَبُوهُ مِنَ ٱلْكِتَـٰبِ وَمَا هُوَ مِنَ ٱلْكِتَـٰبِ وَيَقُولُونَ هُوَ مِنْ عِندِ ٱللَّهِ وَمَا هُوَ مِنْ عِندِ ٱللَّهِ وَيَقُولُونَ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ ٱلْكَذِبَ وَهُمْ يَعْلَمُونَ
ayahs.text_normalized: وان منهم لفريقا يلون السنتهم بالكتاب لتحسبوه من الكتاب وما هو من الكتاب ويقولون هو من عند الله وما هو من عند الله ويقولون علي الله الكذب وهم يعلمون

translation.literal: And indeed among them surely (is) a group  they distort their tongues in (reciting) the Book so that you may think it (is) from the Book and not it (is) from the Book And they say It (is) from Allah But not it (is) from Allah And they say about Allah the lie while they know

ayahs.text_normalized: لن يضروكم الا اذي وان يقاتلوكم يولوكم الادبار ثم لا ينصرون

translation.literal: Never will they harm you except a hurt And if they fight you they will turn (towards) you the backs then not they will be helped
translation.natural: They will not harm you except for [some] annoyance. And if they fight you, they will show you their backs [i.e., retreat]; then they will not be aided.

ayahs.text_uthmani: ضُرِبَتْ عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلذِّلَّةُ أَيْنَ مَا ثُقِفُوٓا۟ إِلَّا بِحَبْلٍۢ مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ وَحَبْلٍۢ مِّنَ ٱلنَّاسِ وَبَآءُو بِغَضَبٍۢ مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ وَضُرِبَتْ عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلْمَسْكَنَةُ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ يَكْفُرُونَ بِـَٔايَـٰتِ ٱللَّهِ وَيَقْتُلُونَ ٱلْأَنۢبِيَآءَ بِغَيْرِ حَقٍّۢ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ بِمَا عَصَوا۟ وَّكَانُوا۟ يَعْتَدُونَ
ayahs.text_normalized: ضربت عليهم الذله اين ما ثقفوا الا بحبل من الله وحبل من الناس وباءو بغضب من الله وضربت عليهم المسكنه ذالك بانهم كانوا يكفرون بايات الله ويقتلون الانبياء بغير حق ذالك بما عصوا وكانوا يعتدون

translation.literal: Struck on them the humiliation wherever that they are found except with a rope from Allah and a rope from the people And they incurred wrath from Allah and struck on them the poverty That (is) because they used to disbelieve in (the) Verses (of) Allah and they killed the Prophets without right That (is) because they disobeyed and they used to transgress
translation.natural: They have been put under humiliation [by Allāh] wherever they are overtaken, except for a rope [i.e., covenant] from Allāh and a rope [i.e., treaty] from the people [i.e., the Muslims].<sup foot_note=196071>1</sup> And they have drawn upon themselves anger from Allāh and have been put under destitution. That is because they disbelieved in [i.e., rejected] the verses of Allāh and killed the prophets without right. That is because they disobeyed and [habitually] transgressed.
translation.grammar_sensitive: Structured syntactic reading: They have been put under humiliation [by Allāh] wherever they are overtaken, except for a rope [i.e., covenant] from Allāh and a rope [i.e., treaty] from the people [i.e., the Muslims].<sup foot_note=196071>1</sup> And they have drawn upon themselves anger from Allāh and have been put under destitution. That is because they disbelieved in [i.e., rejected] the verses of Allāh and killed the prophets without right. That is because they disobeyed and [habitually] transgressed.

ayahs.text_uthmani: ۞ لَيْسُوا۟ سَوَآءًۭ ۗ مِّنْ أَهْلِ ٱلْكِتَـٰبِ أُمَّةٌۭ قَآئِمَةٌۭ يَتْلُونَ ءَايَـٰتِ ٱللَّهِ ءَانَآءَ ٱلَّيْلِ وَهُمْ يَسْجُدُونَ

translation.literal: They are not (the) same among (the) People (of) the Book (is) a community standing (and) reciting (the) Verses (of) Allah (in the) hours (of) the night and they prostrate
translation.natural: They are not [all] the same; among the People of the Scripture is a community<sup foot_note=196072>1</sup> standing [in obedience], reciting the verses of Allāh during periods of the night and prostrating [in prayer].

ayahs.text_uthmani: يُؤْمِنُونَ بِٱللَّهِ وَٱلْيَوْمِ ٱلْـَٔاخِرِ وَيَأْمُرُونَ بِٱلْمَعْرُوفِ وَيَنْهَوْنَ عَنِ ٱلْمُنكَرِ وَيُسَـٰرِعُونَ فِى ٱلْخَيْرَٰتِ وَأُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ مِنَ ٱلصَّـٰلِحِينَ
ayahs.text_normalized: يؤمنون بالله واليوم الاخر ويامرون بالمعروف وينهون عن المنكر ويسارعون في الخيرات واولائك من الصالحين

translation.literal: They believe in Allah and the Day the Last and they enjoin [with] the right and forbid [from] the wrong and they hasten in the good deeds And those (are) from the righteous
translation.natural: They believe in Allāh and the Last Day, and they enjoin what is right and forbid what is wrong and hasten to good deeds. And those are among the righteous.

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَمَا يَفْعَلُوا۟ مِنْ خَيْرٍۢ فَلَن يُكْفَرُوهُ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ عَلِيمٌۢ بِٱلْمُتَّقِينَ

translation.literal: And whatever they do of a good then never will they be denied it And Allah (is) All-Knowing of the God-fearing
translation.natural: And whatever good they do - never will it be denied them. And Allāh is Knowing of the righteous.

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لَن تُغْنِىَ عَنْهُمْ أَمْوَٰلُهُمْ وَلَآ أَوْلَـٰدُهُم مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ شَيْـًۭٔا ۖ وَأُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ أَصْحَـٰبُ ٱلنَّارِ ۚ هُمْ فِيهَا خَـٰلِدُونَ
ayahs.text_normalized: ان الذين كفروا لن تغني عنهم اموالهم ولا اولادهم من الله شيا واولائك اصحاب النار هم فيها خالدون

translation.literal: Indeed those who disbelieved never will avail [for] them their wealth and not their children against Allah anything and those (are the) companions (of) the Fire they in it (will) abide forever
translation.natural: Indeed, those who disbelieve - never will their wealth or their children avail them against Allāh at all, and those are the companions of the Fire; they will abide therein eternally.

ayahs.text_uthmani: مَثَلُ مَا يُنفِقُونَ فِى هَـٰذِهِ ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنْيَا كَمَثَلِ رِيحٍۢ فِيهَا صِرٌّ أَصَابَتْ حَرْثَ قَوْمٍۢ ظَلَمُوٓا۟ أَنفُسَهُمْ فَأَهْلَكَتْهُ ۚ وَمَا ظَلَمَهُمُ ٱللَّهُ وَلَـٰكِنْ أَنفُسَهُمْ يَظْلِمُونَ
ayahs.text_normalized: مثل ما ينفقون في هاذه الحيواه الدنيا كمثل ريح فيها صر اصابت حرث قوم ظلموا انفسهم فاهلكته وما ظلمهم الله ولاكن انفسهم يظلمون

translation.literal: Example (of) what they spend in this [the] life (of) the world (is) like (the) example (of) a wind in it (is) frost it struck (the) harvest (of) a people who wronged themselves then destroyed it And not (has) wronged them Allah [and] but themselves they wronged
translation.natural: The example of what they spend in this worldly life is like that of a wind containing frost which strikes the harvest of a people who have wronged themselves [i.e., sinned] and destroys it. And Allāh has not wronged them, but they wrong themselves.
translation.grammar_sensitive: Structured syntactic reading: The example of what they spend in this worldly life is like that of a wind containing frost which strikes the harvest of a people who have wronged themselves [i.e., sinned] and destroys it. And Allāh has not wronged them, but they wrong themselves.

ayahs.text_uthmani: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ لَا تَتَّخِذُوا۟ بِطَانَةًۭ مِّن دُونِكُمْ لَا يَأْلُونَكُمْ خَبَالًۭا وَدُّوا۟ مَا عَنِتُّمْ قَدْ بَدَتِ ٱلْبَغْضَآءُ مِنْ أَفْوَٰهِهِمْ وَمَا تُخْفِى صُدُورُهُمْ أَكْبَرُ ۚ قَدْ بَيَّنَّا لَكُمُ ٱلْـَٔايَـٰتِ ۖ إِن كُنتُمْ تَعْقِلُونَ
ayahs.text_normalized: ياايها الذين ءامنوا لا تتخذوا بطانه من دونكم لا يالونكم خبالا ودوا ما عنتم قد بدت البغضاء من افواههم وما تخفي صدورهم اكبر قد بينا لكم الايات ان كنتم تعقلون

translation.literal: O you who believe[d] (Do) not take (as) intimates from other than yourselves not they will spare you (any) ruin They wish what distresses you Indeed (has become) apparent the hatred from their mouths and what conceals their breasts (is) greater Certainly We made clear for you the Verses if you were (to use) reason
translation.natural: O you who have believed, do not take as intimates those other than yourselves [i.e., believers], for they will not spare you [any] ruin. They wish you would have hardship. Hatred has already appeared from their mouths, and what their breasts conceal is greater. We have certainly made clear to you the signs, if you will use reason.

They wish you would have hardship. Hatred has already appeared from their mouths, and what their breasts conceal is greater. We have certainly made clear to you the signs, if you will use reason.

ayahs.text_uthmani: هَـٰٓأَنتُمْ أُو۟لَآءِ تُحِبُّونَهُمْ وَلَا يُحِبُّونَكُمْ وَتُؤْمِنُونَ بِٱلْكِتَـٰبِ كُلِّهِۦ وَإِذَا لَقُوكُمْ قَالُوٓا۟ ءَامَنَّا وَإِذَا خَلَوْا۟ عَضُّوا۟ عَلَيْكُمُ ٱلْأَنَامِلَ مِنَ ٱلْغَيْظِ ۚ قُلْ مُوتُوا۟ بِغَيْظِكُمْ ۗ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَلِيمٌۢ بِذَاتِ ٱلصُّدُورِ
ayahs.text_normalized: هاانتم اولاء تحبونهم ولا يحبونكم وتؤمنون بالكتاب كله واذا لقوكم قالوا ءامنا واذا خلوا عضوا عليكم الانامل من الغيظ قل موتوا بغيظكم ان الله عليم بذات الصدور

translation.literal: Lo! You are those you love them but not they love you and you believe in the Book  all of it And when they meet you they say We believe And when they are alone they bite at you the finger tips (out) of [the] rage Say Die in your rage Indeed Allah (is) All-Knowing of what (is in) the breasts
translation.natural: Here you are loving them but they are not loving you, while you believe in the Scripture - all of it.<sup foot_note=196073>1</sup> And when they meet you, they say, "We believe." But when they are alone, they bite their fingertips at you in rage. Say, "Die in your rage. Indeed, Allāh is Knowing of that within the breasts."

But when they are alone, they bite their fingertips at you in rage. Say, "Die in your rage. Indeed, Allāh is Knowing of that within the breasts."

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِن تَمْسَسْكُمْ حَسَنَةٌۭ تَسُؤْهُمْ وَإِن تُصِبْكُمْ سَيِّئَةٌۭ يَفْرَحُوا۟ بِهَا ۖ وَإِن تَصْبِرُوا۟ وَتَتَّقُوا۟ لَا يَضُرُّكُمْ كَيْدُهُمْ شَيْـًٔا ۗ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ بِمَا يَعْمَلُونَ مُحِيطٌۭ
ayahs.text_normalized: ان تمسسكم حسنه تسؤهم وان تصبكم سيئه يفرحوا بها وان تصبروا وتتقوا لا يضركم كيدهم شيا ان الله بما يعملون محيط

translation.literal: If touches you a good it grieves them and if strikes you misfortune they rejoice at it And if you are patient and fear (Allah) not will harm you their plot (in) anything Indeed Allah of what they do (is) All-Encompassing
translation.natural: If good touches you, it distresses them; but if harm strikes you, they rejoice at it. And if you are patient and fear Allāh, their plot will not harm you at all. Indeed, Allāh is encompassing of what they do.
translation.grammar_sensitive: Structured syntactic reading: If good touches you, it distresses them; but if harm strikes you, they rejoice at it. And if you are patient and fear Allāh, their plot will not harm you at all. Indeed, Allāh is encompassing of what they do.

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَإِذْ غَدَوْتَ مِنْ أَهْلِكَ تُبَوِّئُ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ مَقَـٰعِدَ لِلْقِتَالِ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ سَمِيعٌ عَلِيمٌ

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِذْ هَمَّت طَّآئِفَتَانِ مِنكُمْ أَن تَفْشَلَا وَٱللَّهُ وَلِيُّهُمَا ۗ وَعَلَى ٱللَّهِ فَلْيَتَوَكَّلِ ٱلْمُؤْمِنُونَ
ayahs.text_normalized: اذ همت طائفتان منكم ان تفشلا والله وليهما وعلي الله فليتوكل المؤمنون

translation.natural: When two parties among you were about to lose courage, but Allāh was their ally; and upon Allāh the believers should rely.

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَلَقَدْ نَصَرَكُمُ ٱللَّهُ بِبَدْرٍۢ وَأَنتُمْ أَذِلَّةٌۭ ۖ فَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَشْكُرُونَ

translation.literal: And certainly helped you Allah in Badr while you (were) weak So fear Allah so that you may (be) grateful
translation.natural: And already had Allāh given you victory at [the battle of] Badr while you were weak [i.e., few in number]. Then fear Allāh; perhaps you will be grateful.
translation.grammar_sensitive: Structured syntactic reading: And already had Allāh given you victory at [the battle of] Badr while you were weak [i.e., few in number]. Then fear Allāh; perhaps you will be grateful.

translation.literal: Yes if you are patient and fear (Allah) and they come upon you [of] suddenly [this] will reinforce you your Lord with five thousand[s] [of] [the] Angels [the ones] having marks

ayahs.text_normalized: وما كان لنفس ان تموت الا باذن الله كتابا مؤجلا ومن يرد ثواب الدنيا نؤته منها ومن يرد ثواب الاخره نؤته منها وسنجزي الشاكرين

translation.literal: And not is for a soul that he dies except by (the) permission (of) Allah (at a) decree determined And whoever desires reward (of) the world  We will give him thereof and whoever desires reward (of) the Hereafter We will give him thereof And We will reward the grateful ones

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَكَأَيِّن مِّن نَّبِىٍّۢ قَـٰتَلَ مَعَهُۥ رِبِّيُّونَ كَثِيرٌۭ فَمَا وَهَنُوا۟ لِمَآ أَصَابَهُمْ فِى سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ وَمَا ضَعُفُوا۟ وَمَا ٱسْتَكَانُوا۟ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ يُحِبُّ ٱلصَّـٰبِرِينَ
ayahs.text_normalized: وكاين من نبي قاتل معه ربيون كثير فما وهنوا لما اصابهم في سبيل الله وما ضعفوا وما استكانوا والله يحب الصابرين

translation.literal: And how many from a Prophet fought with him (were) religious scholars many But not they lost heart for what befell them in (the) way (of) Allah and not they weakened and not they gave in And Allah loves the patient ones
translation.natural: And how many a prophet [fought in battle and] with him fought many religious scholars. But they never lost assurance due to what afflicted them in the cause of Allāh, nor did they weaken or submit. And Allāh loves the steadfast.

ayahs.text_uthmani: سَنُلْقِى فِى قُلُوبِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ ٱلرُّعْبَ بِمَآ أَشْرَكُوا۟ بِٱللَّهِ مَا لَمْ يُنَزِّلْ بِهِۦ سُلْطَـٰنًۭا ۖ وَمَأْوَىٰهُمُ ٱلنَّارُ ۚ وَبِئْسَ مَثْوَى ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ
ayahs.text_normalized: سنلقي في قلوب الذين كفروا الرعب بما اشركوا بالله ما لم ينزل به سلطانا وماوياهم النار وبئس مثوي الظالمين

translation.literal: We will cast in (the) hearts (of) those who disbelieve [the] terror because they associated partners with Allah what not He sent down about it any authority and their refuge (will be) the Fire and wretched (is the) abode [of] the wrongdoers
translation.natural: We will cast terror into the hearts of those who disbelieve for what they have associated with Allāh of which He had not sent down [any] authority.<sup foot_note=196074>1</sup> And their refuge will be the Fire, and wretched is the residence of the wrongdoers.

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَلَقَدْ صَدَقَكُمُ ٱللَّهُ وَعْدَهُۥٓ إِذْ تَحُسُّونَهُم بِإِذْنِهِۦ ۖ حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا فَشِلْتُمْ وَتَنَـٰزَعْتُمْ فِى ٱلْأَمْرِ وَعَصَيْتُم مِّنۢ بَعْدِ مَآ أَرَىٰكُم مَّا تُحِبُّونَ ۚ مِنكُم مَّن يُرِيدُ ٱلدُّنْيَا وَمِنكُم مَّن يُرِيدُ ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةَ ۚ ثُمَّ صَرَفَكُمْ عَنْهُمْ لِيَبْتَلِيَكُمْ ۖ وَلَقَدْ عَفَا عَنكُمْ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ ذُو فَضْلٍ عَلَى ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
ayahs.text_normalized: ولقد صدقكم الله وعده اذ تحسونهم باذنه حتيا اذا فشلتم وتنازعتم في الامر وعصيتم من بعد ما ارياكم ما تحبون منكم من يريد الدنيا ومنكم من يريد الاخره ثم صرفكم عنهم ليبتليكم ولقد عفا عنكم والله ذو فضل علي المؤمنين

translation.literal: And certainly fulfilled to you Allah His promise when you were killing them by His permission until when you lost courage and you fell into dispute concerning the order and you disobeyed from after [what] He (had) shown you what you love Among you (are some) who desire the world and among you (are some) who desire the Hereafter Then He diverted you from them so that He may test you And surely He forgave you And Allah (is the) Possessor (of) Bounty for the believers
translation.natural: And Allāh had certainly fulfilled His promise to you when you were killing them [i.e., the enemy] by His permission until [the time] when you lost courage and fell to disputing about the order [given by the Prophet (ﷺ)] and disobeyed after He had shown you that which you love.<sup foot_note=196075>1</sup> Among you are some who desire this world, and among you are some who desire the Hereafter. Then He turned you back from them [defeated] that He might test you. And He has already forgiven you, and Allāh is the possessor of bounty for the believers.

Then He turned you back from them [defeated] that He might test you. And He has already forgiven you, and Allāh is the possessor of bounty for the believers.

ayahs.text_uthmani: ۞ إِذْ تُصْعِدُونَ وَلَا تَلْوُۥنَ عَلَىٰٓ أَحَدٍۢ وَٱلرَّسُولُ يَدْعُوكُمْ فِىٓ أُخْرَىٰكُمْ فَأَثَـٰبَكُمْ غَمًّۢا بِغَمٍّۢ لِّكَيْلَا تَحْزَنُوا۟ عَلَىٰ مَا فَاتَكُمْ وَلَا مَآ أَصَـٰبَكُمْ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ خَبِيرٌۢ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ
ayahs.text_normalized: اذ تصعدون ولا تلون عليا احد والرسول يدعوكم في اخرياكم فاثابكم غما بغم لكيلا تحزنوا عليا ما فاتكم ولا ما اصابكم والله خبير بما تعملون

translation.literal: When you were running uphill and not casting a glance on anyone while the Messenger was calling you [in] (from) behind you So (He) repaid you (with) distress on distress so that not you grieve over what escaped you and not what (had) befallen you And Allah (is) All-Aware of what you do
translation.natural: [Remember] when you [fled and] climbed [the mountain] without looking aside at anyone while the Messenger was calling you from behind. So Allāh repaid you with distress upon distress so you would not grieve for that which had escaped you [of victory and spoils of war] or [for] that which had befallen you [of injury and death]. And Allāh is [fully] Aware of what you do.

ayahs.text_uthmani: ثُمَّ أَنزَلَ عَلَيْكُم مِّنۢ بَعْدِ ٱلْغَمِّ أَمَنَةًۭ نُّعَاسًۭا يَغْشَىٰ طَآئِفَةًۭ مِّنكُمْ ۖ وَطَآئِفَةٌۭ قَدْ أَهَمَّتْهُمْ أَنفُسُهُمْ يَظُنُّونَ بِٱللَّهِ غَيْرَ ٱلْحَقِّ ظَنَّ ٱلْجَـٰهِلِيَّةِ ۖ يَقُولُونَ هَل لَّنَا مِنَ ٱلْأَمْرِ مِن شَىْءٍۢ ۗ قُلْ إِنَّ ٱلْأَمْرَ كُلَّهُۥ لِلَّهِ ۗ يُخْفُونَ فِىٓ أَنفُسِهِم مَّا لَا يُبْدُونَ لَكَ ۖ يَقُولُونَ لَوْ كَانَ لَنَا مِنَ ٱلْأَمْرِ شَىْءٌۭ مَّا قُتِلْنَا هَـٰهُنَا ۗ قُل لَّوْ كُنتُمْ فِى بُيُوتِكُمْ لَبَرَزَ ٱلَّذِينَ كُتِبَ عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلْقَتْلُ إِلَىٰ مَضَاجِعِهِمْ ۖ وَلِيَبْتَلِىَ ٱللَّهُ مَا فِى صُدُورِكُمْ وَلِيُمَحِّصَ مَا فِى قُلُوبِكُمْ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ عَلِيمٌۢ بِذَاتِ ٱلصُّدُورِ
ayahs.text_normalized: ثم انزل عليكم من بعد الغم امنه نعاسا يغشيا طائفه منكم وطائفه قد اهمتهم انفسهم يظنون بالله غير الحق ظن الجاهليه يقولون هل لنا من الامر من شيء قل ان الامر كله لله يخفون في انفسهم ما لا يبدون لك يقولون لو كان لنا من الامر شيء ما قتلنا هاهنا قل لو كنتم في بيوتكم لبرز الذين كتب عليهم القتل اليا مضاجعهم وليبتلي الله ما في صدوركم وليمحص ما في قلوبكم والله عليم بذات الصدور

translation.literal: Then He sent down upon you from after the distress security  slumber overcoming a group of you while a group certainly worried [them] (about) themselves thinking about Allah other than the truth  (the) thought (of) [the] ignorance saying Is (there) for us from the matter any thing Say Indeed the matter all (of) it (is) for Allah They hide in themselves what not they reveal to you They say If was for us from the matter anything not we would have been killed here Say If you were in your houses surely (would have) come out those who  was decreed upon them [the] death towards their places of death And that might test Allah what (is) in your breasts and that He may purge what (is) in your hearts And Allah (is) All-Aware of what (is in) the breasts
translation.natural: Then after distress, He sent down upon you security [in the form of] drowsiness, overcoming a faction of you, while another faction worried about themselves, thinking of Allāh other than the truth - the thought of ignorance, saying, "Is there anything for us [to have done] in this matter?" Say, "Indeed, the matter belongs completely to Allāh." They conceal within themselves what they will not reveal to you. They say, "If there was anything we could have done in the matter, we [i.e., some of us] would not have been killed right here." Say, "Even if you had been inside your houses, those decreed to be killed would have come out to their death beds." [It was] so that Allāh might test what is in your breasts and purify what is in your hearts. And Allāh is Knowing of that within the breasts.

ayahs.text_uthmani: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ تَوَلَّوْا۟ مِنكُمْ يَوْمَ ٱلْتَقَى ٱلْجَمْعَانِ إِنَّمَا ٱسْتَزَلَّهُمُ ٱلشَّيْطَـٰنُ بِبَعْضِ مَا كَسَبُوا۟ ۖ وَلَقَدْ عَفَا ٱللَّهُ عَنْهُمْ ۗ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَفُورٌ حَلِيمٌۭ
ayahs.text_normalized: ان الذين تولوا منكم يوم التقي الجمعان انما استزلهم الشيطان ببعض ما كسبوا ولقد عفا الله عنهم ان الله غفور حليم

translation.literal: Indeed those who turned back among you (on the) day met the two hosts  only made them slip the Shaitaan for some (of) what they (had) earned And surely forgave Allah [on] them indeed Allah (is) Oft-Forgiving All-Forbearing
translation.natural: Indeed, those of you who turned back on the day the two armies met [at Uḥud] - it was Satan who caused them to slip because of some [blame] they had earned. But Allāh has already forgiven them. Indeed, Allāh is Forgiving and Forbearing.

ayahs.text_uthmani: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ لَا تَكُونُوا۟ كَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ وَقَالُوا۟ لِإِخْوَٰنِهِمْ إِذَا ضَرَبُوا۟ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ أَوْ كَانُوا۟ غُزًّۭى لَّوْ كَانُوا۟ عِندَنَا مَا مَاتُوا۟ وَمَا قُتِلُوا۟ لِيَجْعَلَ ٱللَّهُ ذَٰلِكَ حَسْرَةًۭ فِى قُلُوبِهِمْ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ يُحْىِۦ وَيُمِيتُ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ بَصِيرٌۭ
ayahs.text_normalized: ياايها الذين ءامنوا لا تكونوا كالذين كفروا وقالوا لاخوانهم اذا ضربوا في الارض او كانوا غزي لو كانوا عندنا ما ماتوا وما قتلوا ليجعل الله ذالك حسره في قلوبهم والله يحي ويميت والله بما تعملون بصير

translation.literal: O you who believe[d] (Do) not be like those who disbelieved and they said about their brothers when they traveled in the earth or they were fighting If they had been with us not they (would have) died and not they (would have) been killed So makes Allah that a regret in their hearts And Allah gives life and causes death and Allah of what you do (is) All-Seer
translation.natural: O you who have believed, do not be like those who disbelieved and said about their brothers when they traveled through the land or went out to fight, "If they had been with us, they would not have died or have been killed," so Allāh makes that [misconception] a regret within their hearts. And it is Allāh who gives life and causes death, and Allāh is Seeing of what you do.

translation.literal: So because (of) Mercy from Allah you dealt gently with them And if you had been rude (and) harsh (at) [the] heart surely they (would have) dispersed from around you Then pardon [from] them and ask forgiveness for them and consult them in the matter Then when you have decided then put trust on Allah Indeed Allah loves the ones who put trust (in Him)

translation.literal: And not is for a Prophet that he defrauds And whoever defrauds will bring what he had defrauded (on the) Day (of) Resurrection Then is repaid in full every soul what it earned and they (will) not be wronged
translation.natural: It is not [attributable] to any prophet that he would act unfaithfully [in regard to war booty]. ayahs.text_normalized: الذين استجابوا لله والرسول من بعد ما اصابهم القرح للذين احسنوا منهم واتقوا اجر عظيم

ayahs.text_uthmani: ٱلَّذِينَ قَالَ لَهُمُ ٱلنَّاسُ إِنَّ ٱلنَّاسَ قَدْ جَمَعُوا۟ لَكُمْ فَٱخْشَوْهُمْ فَزَادَهُمْ إِيمَـٰنًۭا وَقَالُوا۟ حَسْبُنَا ٱللَّهُ وَنِعْمَ ٱلْوَكِيلُ
ayahs.text_normalized: الذين قال لهم الناس ان الناس قد جمعوا لكم فاخشوهم فزادهم ايمانا وقالوا حسبنا الله ونعم الوكيل

translation.literal: Those who said to them [the people] Indeed the people (have) certainly gathered against you so fear them But it increased them (in) faith and they said Sufficient for us (is) Allah and (He is the) best [the] Disposer of affairs
translation.natural: Those to whom people [i.e., hypocrites] said, "Indeed, the people have gathered against you, so fear them." But it [merely] increased them in faith, and they said, "Sufficient for us is Allāh, and [He is] the best Disposer of affairs."<sup foot_note=196077>1</sup>

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَلَا يَحْزُنكَ ٱلَّذِينَ يُسَـٰرِعُونَ فِى ٱلْكُفْرِ ۚ إِنَّهُمْ لَن يَضُرُّوا۟ ٱللَّهَ شَيْـًۭٔا ۗ يُرِيدُ ٱللَّهُ أَلَّا يَجْعَلَ لَهُمْ حَظًّۭا فِى ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ ۖ وَلَهُمْ عَذَابٌ عَظِيمٌ
ayahs.text_normalized: ولا يحزنك الذين يسارعون في الكفر انهم لن يضروا الله شيا يريد الله الا يجعل لهم حظا في الاخره ولهم عذاب عظيم

translation.literal: And (let) not grieve you those who hasten in(to) [the] disbelief Indeed, they never will harm Allah (in) anything intends Allah that not He will set for them any portion in the Hereafter And for them (is) a punishment great
translation.natural: And do not be grieved, [O Muḥammad], by those who hasten into disbelief. Indeed, they will never harm Allāh at all. Allāh intends that He should give them no share in the Hereafter, and for them is a great punishment.

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَلَا يَحْسَبَنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوٓا۟ أَنَّمَا نُمْلِى لَهُمْ خَيْرٌۭ لِّأَنفُسِهِمْ ۚ إِنَّمَا نُمْلِى لَهُمْ لِيَزْدَادُوٓا۟ إِثْمًۭا ۚ وَلَهُمْ عَذَابٌۭ مُّهِينٌۭ
ayahs.text_normalized: ولا يحسبن الذين كفروا انما نملي لهم خير لانفسهم انما نملي لهم ليزدادوا اثما ولهم عذاب مهين

translation.literal: And (let) not think those who disbelieved that We give respite to them (is) good for themselves Only We give respite to them so that they may increase (in) sins and for them (is) a punishment humiliating
translation.natural: And let not those who disbelieve ever think that [because] We extend their time [of enjoyment] it is better for them. We only extend it for them so that they may increase in sin, and for them is a humiliating punishment.

ayahs.text_uthmani: مَّا كَانَ ٱللَّهُ لِيَذَرَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ عَلَىٰ مَآ أَنتُمْ عَلَيْهِ حَتَّىٰ يَمِيزَ ٱلْخَبِيثَ مِنَ ٱلطَّيِّبِ ۗ وَمَا كَانَ ٱللَّهُ لِيُطْلِعَكُمْ عَلَى ٱلْغَيْبِ وَلَـٰكِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَجْتَبِى مِن رُّسُلِهِۦ مَن يَشَآءُ ۖ فَـَٔامِنُوا۟ بِٱللَّهِ وَرُسُلِهِۦ ۚ وَإِن تُؤْمِنُوا۟ وَتَتَّقُوا۟ فَلَكُمْ أَجْرٌ عَظِيمٌۭ
ayahs.text_normalized: ما كان الله ليذر المؤمنين عليا ما انتم عليه حتيا يميز الخبيث من الطيب وما كان الله ليطلعكم علي الغيب ولاكن الله يجتبي من رسله من يشاء فامنوا بالله ورسله وان تؤمنوا وتتقوا فلكم اجر عظيم

translation.literal: Not is Allah to leave the believers on what you (are) in [it] until He separates the evil from the good And not is Allah to inform you about the unseen [and] but Allah chooses from His Messengers whom He wills so believe in Allah and His Messengers and if you believe and fear (Allah) then for you (is a) reward great
translation.natural: Allāh would not leave the believers in that [state] you are in [presently] until He separates the evil from the good. Nor would Allāh reveal to you the unseen. But [instead], Allāh chooses of His messengers whom He wills, so believe in Allāh and His messengers. And if you believe and fear Him, then for you is a great reward.
translation.grammar_sensitive: Structured syntactic reading: Allāh would not leave the believers in that [state] you are in [presently] until He separates the evil from the good. Nor would Allāh reveal to you the unseen. But [instead], Allāh chooses of His messengers whom He wills, so believe in Allāh and His messengers. And if you believe and fear Him, then for you is a great reward.

ayahs.text_uthmani: وَلَا يَحْسَبَنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يَبْخَلُونَ بِمَآ ءَاتَىٰهُمُ ٱللَّهُ مِن فَضْلِهِۦ هُوَ خَيْرًۭا لَّهُم ۖ بَلْ هُوَ شَرٌّۭ لَّهُمْ ۖ سَيُطَوَّقُونَ مَا بَخِلُوا۟ بِهِۦ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَـٰمَةِ ۗ وَلِلَّهِ مِيرَٰثُ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ خَبِيرٌۭ
ayahs.text_normalized: ولا يحسبن الذين يبخلون بما ءاتياهم الله من فضله هو خيرا لهم بل هو شر لهم سيطوقون ما بخلوا به يوم القيامه ولله ميراث السماوات والارض والله بما تعملون خبير

translation.literal: And (let) not think those who withhold of what (has) given them Allah of His Bounty (that) it (is) good for them Nay it (is) bad for them Their necks will be encircled (with) what they withheld [with it] (on the) Day (of) [the] Resurrection And for Allah (is the) heritage (of) the heavens and the earth And Allah with what you do (is) All-Aware
translation.natural: And let not those who [greedily] withhold what Allāh has given them of His bounty ever think that it is better for them. Rather, it is worse for them. Their necks will be encircled by what they withheld on the Day of Resurrection. And to Allāh belongs the heritage of the heavens and the earth. And Allāh, of what you do, is [fully] Aware.
translation.grammar_sensitive: Structured syntactic reading: And let not those who [greedily] withhold what Allāh has given them of His bounty ever think that it is better for them. And Allāh, of what you do, is [fully] Aware.

ayahs.text_uthmani: لَّقَدْ سَمِعَ ٱللَّهُ قَوْلَ ٱلَّذِينَ قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ فَقِيرٌۭ وَنَحْنُ أَغْنِيَآءُ ۘ سَنَكْتُبُ مَا قَالُوا۟ وَقَتْلَهُمُ ٱلْأَنۢبِيَآءَ بِغَيْرِ حَقٍّۢ وَنَقُولُ ذُوقُوا۟ عَذَابَ ٱلْحَرِيقِ
ayahs.text_normalized: لقد سمع الله قول الذين قالوا ان الله فقير ونحن اغنياء سنكتب ما قالوا وقتلهم الانبياء بغير حق ونقول ذوقوا عذاب الحريق

translation.literal: Certainly heard Allah (the) saying (of) those who said Indeed Allah (is) poor while we (are) rich We will record what they said and their killing the Prophets without (any) right and We will say Taste (the) punishment (of) the Burning Fire
translation.natural: Allāh has certainly heard the statement of those [Jews] who said, "Indeed, Allāh is poor, while we are rich." We will record what they said and their killing of the prophets without right and will say, "Taste the punishment of the Burning Fire.

ayahs.text_uthmani: ٱلَّذِينَ قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَهِدَ إِلَيْنَآ أَلَّا نُؤْمِنَ لِرَسُولٍ حَتَّىٰ يَأْتِيَنَا بِقُرْبَانٍۢ تَأْكُلُهُ ٱلنَّارُ ۗ قُلْ قَدْ جَآءَكُمْ رُسُلٌۭ مِّن قَبْلِى بِٱلْبَيِّنَـٰتِ وَبِٱلَّذِى قُلْتُمْ فَلِمَ قَتَلْتُمُوهُمْ إِن كُنتُمْ صَـٰدِقِينَ
ayahs.text_normalized: الذين قالوا ان الله عهد الينا الا نؤمن لرسول حتيا ياتينا بقربان تاكله النار قل قد جاءكم رسل من قبلي بالبينات وبالذي قلتم فلم قتلتموهم ان كنتم صادقين

translation.literal: Those who said Indeed Allah (has) taken promise from us that not we (should) believe in a Messenger until he brings to us a sacrifice  consumes it the fire Say Surely came to you Messengers from before me with the clear Signs and with what you speak So why you killed them if you are truthful
translation.natural: [They are] those who said, "Indeed, Allāh has taken our promise not to believe any messenger until he brings us an offering which fire [from heaven] will consume." Say, "There have already come to you messengers before me with clear proofs and [even] that of which you speak. So why did you kill them, if you should be truthful?"

ayahs.text_uthmani: فَإِن كَذَّبُوكَ فَقَدْ كُذِّبَ رُسُلٌۭ مِّن قَبْلِكَ جَآءُو بِٱلْبَيِّنَـٰتِ وَٱلزُّبُرِ وَٱلْكِتَـٰبِ ٱلْمُنِيرِ

ayahs.text_uthmani: كُلُّ نَفْسٍۢ ذَآئِقَةُ ٱلْمَوْتِ ۗ وَإِنَّمَا تُوَفَّوْنَ أُجُورَكُمْ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَـٰمَةِ ۖ فَمَن زُحْزِحَ عَنِ ٱلنَّارِ وَأُدْخِلَ ٱلْجَنَّةَ فَقَدْ فَازَ ۗ وَمَا ٱلْحَيَوٰةُ ٱلدُّنْيَآ إِلَّا مَتَـٰعُ ٱلْغُرُورِ
ayahs.text_normalized: كل نفس ذائقه الموت وانما توفون اجوركم يوم القيامه فمن زحزح عن النار وادخل الجنه فقد فاز وما الحيواه الدنيا الا متاع الغرور

translation.literal: Every soul (will) taste [the] death and only you will be paid in full your reward (on the) Day (of) [the] Resurrection Then whoever is drawn away from the Fire and admitted (to) Paradise then surely he is successful And not (is) the life (of) the world except enjoyment (of) delusion
translation.natural: Every soul will taste death, and you will only be given your [full] compensation on the Day of Resurrection. So he who is drawn away from the Fire and admitted to Paradise has attained [his desire]. And what is the life of this world except the enjoyment of delusion.

translation.literal: Then responded to them their Lord Indeed, I (will) not (let go) waste deeds (of the) doer among you [from] (whether) male or female each of you from (the) other So those who emigrated and were driven out from their homes and were harmed in My way and fought and were killed  surely I (will) remove from them their evil deeds and surely I will admit them (to) Gardens flowing from underneath them the rivers  a reward from [near] Allah And Allah  with Him (is the) best reward
translation.natural: And their Lord responded to them, "Never will I allow to be lost the work of [any] worker among you, whether male or female; you are of one another. So those who emigrated or were evicted from their homes or were harmed in My cause or fought or were killed - I will surely remove from them their misdeeds, and I will surely admit them to gardens beneath which rivers flow as reward from Allāh, and Allāh has with Him the best reward."

grammar_rules.definition: The primary grammatical case marking independent agents, actors, sentence topics, and predicates in classical Arabic.
grammar_rules.beginner_explanation: Marks the 'star' of the sentence—the person or thing who does the action, or the main topic being talked about. It usually ends with a Dhumma ('u' sound).
grammar_rules.advanced_explanation: حالة إعرابية أصلية تدل على العمدة في الكلام، وعلامتها الأصلية الضمة، وتنوب عنها الواو في جمع المذكر السالم والأسماء الخمسة، والألف في المثنى، وثبوت النون في الأفعال الخمسة.

grammar_rules.definition: The grammatical case signaling dependency, subordination, receiving an action (direct object), circumstances of time/place, or state (hal).
grammar_rules.beginner_explanation: Marks the receiver of the action—what or who was affected—as well as details like when, where, or how something happened. It usually ends with a Fatha ('a' sound).
grammar_rules.advanced_explanation: حالة إعرابية تدل على الفضلات والمفاعيل وما ألحق بها كالحال والتمييز واسم إن وخبر كان، وعلامتها الأصلية الفتحة.

grammar_rules.definition: The grammatical case exclusive to nouns, indicating relationship governed by a preposition (Harf Jarr) or possessive annexation (Idafah).
grammar_rules.beginner_explanation: Marks attachment or possession—either coming right after a preposition (like 'in', 'on', 'with') or showing belonging ('house of Allah'). It usually ends with a Kasra ('i' sound).
grammar_rules.advanced_explanation: حالة إعرابية تختص بالأسماء، وتكون بحرف الجر أو بالإضافة أو التبعية، وعلامتها الأصلية الكسرة.

grammar_rules.definition: The grammatical state exclusive to imperfect verbs (Mudari'), signaling negation, conditional dependency, or command.
grammar_rules.beginner_explanation: Stops or clips the verb's ending—used after negative particles like 'Lam' (did not) or in conditional 'if' sentences. It usually ends with a Sukun (silent stop).
grammar_rules.advanced_explanation: حالة إعرابية تختص بالفعل المضارع إذا سبقه جازم، وعلامتها الأصلية السكون، أو حذف النون، أو حذف حرف العلة.

grammar_rules.definition: The syntactic state of words whose final short vowel never changes, regardless of grammatical governor.
grammar_rules.beginner_explanation: Words made of 'concrete'—their endings never change no matter where they sit in a sentence (like all particles, past verbs, and pronouns).
grammar_rules.advanced_explanation: لزوم آخر الكلمة حركة أو سكونًا لغير عامل، كالحروف والضمائر وأسماء الإشارة وأفعال الماضي والأمر.

grammar_rules.definition: A syntactic construct binding two nouns together where the first (Mudhaf) is possessed or qualified by the second (Mudhaf Ilayh in genitive).
grammar_rules.beginner_explanation: Two nouns glued together to show possession: 'Word of Allah', 'Messenger of God'. The first drops its 'Tanween' or 'Al-' and the second is in the Genitive.
grammar_rules.advanced_explanation: نسبة تقييدية بين اسمين توجب جر الثاني دائمًا وتجريد الأول من التنوين ونوني المثنى والجمع.

grammar_rules.definition: A compound syntactic structure linking a condition (Shart) to an apodosis/result (Jawab al-Shart).
grammar_rules.beginner_explanation: An 'if-then' statement: 'If you do this, that will happen.' Both the condition and the result verbs often take the clipped jussive mood.
grammar_rules.advanced_explanation: تركيب يربط بين جملتين بأداة شرط، بحيث يكون مضمون الجملة الأولى سببًا وشرطًا في تحقق مضمون الثانية.
examples: إِن تَتَّقُوا اللَّهَ يَجْعَل لَّكُمْ فُرْقَانًا

sarf_rules.rule: The root consists of three bare consonantal radicals without augmentation: ف-ع-ل.
sarf_rules.beginner_explanation: The fundamental, core 3-letter verb pattern from which all other forms branch out.
sarf_rules.advanced_explanation: الفعل الخالي من أحرف الزيادة، وتأتي عين ماضيه مفتوحة أو مكسورة أو مضمومة (فَعَلَ، فَعِلَ، فَعُلَ).

sarf_rules.rule: Formed by doubling the second radical (عين الفعل) with Shaddah: فَعَّلَ / يُفَعِّلُ / تَفْعِيل.
sarf_rules.beginner_explanation: Doubling the middle letter to make an action causative (making someone do it) or intensive (doing it thoroughly).
sarf_rules.advanced_explanation: مزيد بحرف واحد بتضعيف العين، ويفيد التعدية والتكثير والنسبة والجعل.

sarf_rules.rule: Formed by inserting an Alif after the first radical: فَاعَلَ / يُفَاعِلُ / مُفَاعَلَة.
sarf_rules.beginner_explanation: Adding an Alif after the first letter to express reciprocal action or striving against another.
sarf_rules.advanced_explanation: مزيد بحرف واحد وهو الألف بعد الفاء، ويفيد المشاركة بين اثنين فصاعدًا أو الموالاة.

sarf_rules.rule: Formed by prefixing a Hamzah with Fatha to the root: أَفْعَلَ / يُفْعِلُ / إِفْعَال.
sarf_rules.beginner_explanation: Adding an 'A-' sound at the front to make an intransitive action affect someone else (cause something to happen).
sarf_rules.advanced_explanation: مزيد بحرف واحد وهو الهمزة في أوله، وأشهر معانيه التعدية والصيرورة والدخول في الزمان أو المكان.

sarf_rules.rule: Formed by prefixing Ta' and doubling the second radical: تَفَعَّلَ / يَتَفَعَّلُ / تَفَعُّل.
sarf_rules.beginner_explanation: Reflexive of Form II, expressing internalizing an action or doing something gradually step by step.
sarf_rules.advanced_explanation: مزيد بحرفين: التاء وتضعيف العين، ويفيد مطاوعة فعّل والتكلف والتدريج.

sarf_rules.rule: Formed by prefixing Ta' and inserting an Alif: تَفَاعَلَ / يَتَفَاعَلُ / تَفَاعُل.
sarf_rules.beginner_explanation: Expresses mutual, two-way interaction between multiple parties.
sarf_rules.advanced_explanation: مزيد بحرفين: التاء والألف، ويفيد المشاركة بين اثنين فأكثر والتظاهر بالشيء.

sarf_rules.rule: Formed by prefixing Hamzat al-wasl and infixed Ta' after first radical: افْتَعَلَ / يَفْتَعِلُ / افْتِعَال.
sarf_rules.beginner_explanation: Expresses earnest effort, diligence, or performing an action for one's own benefit.
sarf_rules.advanced_explanation: مزيد بحرفين: الهمزة والتاء بعد الفاء، ويفيد الاجتهاد والاكتساب والاتخاذ والمطاوعة.

sarf_rules.rule: Formed by prefixing 'Ista-' (Hamzah, Seen, Ta'): اسْتَفْعَلَ / يَسْتَفْعِلُ / اسْتِفْعَال.
sarf_rules.beginner_explanation: Adding 'Ista-' to ask for or seek the action of the root (e.g. seeking forgiveness, asking for guidance).
sarf_rules.advanced_explanation: مزيد بثلاثة أحرف: الهمزة والسين والتاء، ويفيد الطلب والاعتقاد والتحول والصيرورة.

learning_insights.observation: Establishes foundational Islamic epistemological principles by dividing verses into 'مُّحْكَمَاتٌ هُنَّ أُمُّ الْكِتَابِ' (decisive, foundational) and 'مُتَشَابِهَاتٌ' (allegorical), warning against those who pursue ambiguity to sow discord.

learning_insights.topic: Divine Witness of Justice and Monotheism
learning_insights.observation: The solemn testimony 'شَهِدَ اللَّهُ أَنَّهُ لَا إِلَـٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ وَالْمَلَائِكَةُ وَأُولُو الْعِلْمِ قَائِمًا بِالْقِسْطِ' joins the testimony of Allah, the angels, and people of knowledge, marked by the circumstantial accusative Hal 'قَائِمًا بِالْقِسْطِ'.

learning_insights.topic: Mortal Reality of Prophethood & Steadfast Faith
learning_insights.observation: Employs the particle of restriction (Hasr) 'وَمَا مُحَمَّدٌ إِلَّا رَسُولٌ قَدْ خَلَتْ مِن قَبْلِهِ الرُّسُلُ', reframing the psychological shock of the rumor of the Prophet's death at Uhud into unflinching spiritual permanence.

learning_insights.topic: Cosmic Reflection of the People of Understanding (Ulul-Albab)
learning_insights.observation: The majestic opening 'إِنَّ فِي خَلْقِ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَاخْتِلَافِ اللَّيْلِ وَالنَّهَارِ لَآيَاتٍ لِّأُولِي الْأَلْبَابِ' employs emphatic Inna and Lam to invite deep contemplation upon the order of the cosmos.
